lines.text: Felt that in the cheap seats!
Danger zone! One hit from gone.
The stage is part of the show!
Heads up, the stage is moving!
Blog Man, front row. Tonight's headline: Unknown Kid With One Skateboard Takes The Floor, Crowd Politely Waits.
Big night at Yo House. Headline: Heavy Walks In, Floor Reportedly Hopes For The Best.
Breaking: Two On One, Panels Tilt, Signal Drops, Nobody Surprised. I'm filing this from the nosebleeds.
Weather alert on Dust Devil Mesa. Headline: Gravity Down Forty-Five Percent, Hair Everywhere, Drama Delivered.
I covered this kid three nights straight. Tonight I'm not in the booth. I'm in the fight. Headline pending.
The show is running long. One stock each, both at one-fifty. Headline: Nobody Gets A Second Chance, Writers Say It Was Always Like This.
Two heavies, and one kid who only has to stay standing for sixty seconds. Front page: Survive, Please.
Encore night. The man who runs the show is on the card, and for once the headline fits on one line: Maestro Steps Out.
Your host, Blog Man. Headline: Champion Returns To The Roof, Fin Spotted In The Crowd, Two Minutes On The Clock.
Ratings night. Three KOs before the clock, and the network wants highlights, not survivors. Headline: Skater Drops In Again, Nobody Asked.
New rule from the network: the champion starts every life already hurt. Headline: Tax Collected In Fog, Receipt Pending.
Tonight's walk-on comes with a sponsor. Headline: Giant Wallet Buys Giant Seats, Champion Still Brought One Skateboard.
Breaking news, and I mean it: tonight's walk-on used to run this show. Headline: Name On The Sheet, Baton In Hand, Champion Gets Top Billing.
Two broadcasts, one hour. Ours has better lighting. Headline: Gravity Turned Up, Rival Network Takes The Credit.
The rival network is airing reruns of the champion with the scores rewritten. Headline: Three KOs In Two Minutes, Or The Tape Wins.
Budget cuts, and the champion goes first. Headline: Smaller Champion, Same Headline, Still Too Long.
Both broadcasts, one channel, and the rival wants to buy the show. Headline: Two On One, Champion Declines The Offer.
Sweeps Week starts with no warning, and the gravity turned down for reasons. Headline: Everything Floats, Ratings Climb.
Tonight's sponsor is also tonight's walk-on, and he pays by the percent. Headline: Three Hundred Percent Or A Refund.
The signal drops for a full minute, and the champion just has to stay on it. Headline: Dead Air, Nobody Touch The Dial.
Last night of sweeps: every highlight, and one live fight with the host in it. That's me. Headline: Host Fights On Air, Sources Say He's Nervous.
First city on the syndication tour: small budget, very good pipe. Headline: Local Affiliate Cannot Afford A Skater.
City two has a censor, so every hit airs at seventy percent. Headline: Family Hour Runs Long.
City three bought the show at its best hour and booked a quota of two hundred percent in eighty seconds. Headline: Prime Time, Prime Pressure.
Every city at once, one live fight, and the network sent two. Headline: The World Is Watching, Mostly On Mute.
The reboot opens on the roof where it started, with a new logo. Headline: Same Show, Bolder Font, One Clean Hit Could End It.
The network added a canned laugh to a fight. Two KOs in ninety seconds. Headline: Nobody Laughs, Ratings Do.
Two shows, one night. Headline: Crossover Event, Nobody Is Sure How This Works, Including Me.
Five clean hits in a row, no cuts, ninety seconds. The editor wants a supercut. Headline: Guest From Next Season Not Allowed To Say How It Goes.
Awards season. Red carpet, and nobody scuffs it. Headline: Champion Nominated, Carpet Nervous.
Two nominees, one category, and a grudge. Headline: Who Is Supporting Whom.
A lifetime award tonight, which takes a quota: two hundred fifty percent of applause in ninety seconds. Headline: Lifetime Not Yet Over.
The big envelope. Four clean hits, and nobody touches the champion. Headline: Acceptance Speech Expected To Be Short.
A thirty-second teaser that shows nothing and ends on a sign-up sheet. Headline: Network Won't Say Whose Name.
Two names, one trailer, one voiceover. Headline: Narrator Dispute, Champion Declines To Comment.
The finale script has a page missing from every copy. Two KOs in ninety seconds will find it. Headline: Missing Page, Network Checking.
A song that doesn't resolve, and a quota of two hundred eighty percent. Headline: Song Ends Mid-Note, Network Calls It Art.
The finale, part one: two sheets on the card, one handwriting. Headline: The Host Steps Out Again, This Time On Purpose.
Part two, back to back, on the roof where it all started. Headline: Series Finale, No Headline Long Enough.
